title: How Students Can Use AI To Study Better - 45s Short

voiceover.text: Here is a better way for students to use AI while studying. If you are stuck on a textbook page, do not ask, teach me this chapter. Show AI the exact page and ask: explain this simply. Next, give context. Tell it your class, the subject, what you already understood, and where you got confused. Then turn the confusion into steps. Ask for a simple explanation, one example, and one question for you to solve. Most important: do not just copy the final answer. Ask AI to quiz you, give hints, and check your answer. The best study setup is simple: AI helps, you practice, and your teacher or textbook verifies.

scenes.caption_body: Show AI the page and ask clearly.
Class + topic + doubt gives better help.
Use AI for hints, quizzes, and feedback.

scenes.caption_title: Use AI like a study coach
scenes.caption_body: AI helps. You practice. Teacher verifies.
